name: falling-platforms
description: Reusable multiplayer game platform on Colyseus with Falling Platforms, Tap Race and Capital Pin.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n server,hub-client,fp-client,tap-client,cp-client "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/server dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/hub-client dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/client dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/tap-race-client dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/capital-pin-client dev"
scripts.dev:falling-platforms: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n server,hub-client,fp-client "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/server dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/hub-client dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/client dev"
scripts.dev:tap-race: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n server,hub-client,tap-client "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/server dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/hub-client dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/tap-race-client dev"
scripts.dev:capital-pin: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n server,hub-client,cp-client "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/server dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/hub-client dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/capital-pin-client dev"
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-shared build && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-schema build && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-server build && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/client-sdk build && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-test build && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/shared build && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/capital-pin build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-shared test && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-schema test && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/platform-server test && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/client-sdk test && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/tap-race test && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/capital-pin test && pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/capital-pin-client test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/client/e2e/playwright.config.ts && pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/tap-race-client/e2e/playwright.config.ts && pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/capital-pin-client/e2e/playwright.config.ts
